lean theorem exists_row_strict_pair (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (v : 𝕜) {x₀ : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx₀A : ∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x₀ j) (hx₀nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x₀ j) (hx₀_val : ∑ j, c j * x₀ j = v) {u₀ : I → 𝕜} (hu₀ : DualFeasible A c u₀) (hu₀_val : ∑ i, u₀ i * b i = v) (i₀ : I) : ∃ (x : Fin n → 𝕜) (u : I → 𝕜), (∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x j) ∧ (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ DualFeasible A c u ∧ (∑ j, c j * x j = v) ∧ (∑ i, u i * b i = v) ∧ 0 < (∑ j, A i₀ j * x j - b i₀) + u i₀
